summary: Iteration 17: WhatsApp inbox NOTES + conversation TAGS feature tested end-to-end (backend + frontend). Backend pytest 21/21 pass. Tags dedup/trim/clear + list presence verified. Notes add/list newest-first with author, empty->422, delete author-or-config.manage guard (rahul->403, priya self->200, priya on rahul note->200 via config.manage, admin->200), 404 on conversation mismatch. RBAC: partner (no leads.view) 403 on GET notes and PUT tags; rahul (leads.view) can read/add. Regression: login priya/rahul OK, GET /api/v1/leads seeded, list conversations, reply within window all OK. Frontend: tags bar [data-testid=wa-tags-bar] with wa-tag-{tag} chips + × remove + wa-tag-input Enter-to-add, adding/removing persists across reload and reflects in conversation list item (chips visible on list card). Notes modal via wa-notes-btn shows wa-notes-list, wa-note-input, wa-note-add; added note shows with author name (Priya) and wa-note-del-{id} delete control that removes it.
critical_code_review_comments: updateTags() correctly trims + de-dupes via array_map('trim') + array_unique + array_filter; empty array clears tags. Cast tags=>array on model ensures JSON persistence.
deleteNote() enforces both conversation ownership (404 on mismatch) and author-or-config.manage (403 otherwise). Clean, correct order of checks.
present() now includes tags => [] fallback so frontend list can safely map chips without null checks.
Notes are always available on any open conversation (independent of 24h window) as intended.
Frontend re-queries the tag chip node after re-render (chip DOM is replaced when saveTags updates state) — noted as a nuance for future tests but functionally fine.

seed_data_creation: Added TEST_iter17 notes and uitest-* tags across 1-2 conversations. Some notes deleted during tests; a couple of TEST_iter17 replies remain. No leads/users created.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Base URL http://127.0.0.1:8000, API /api/v1, Sanctum bearer. Frontend Sign-in button has no type='submit' — use role selector 'Sign in'. Inbox route is hash: #/inbox. Testids: wa-conv-{id}, wa-tags-bar, wa-tag-{tag}, wa-tag-input (Enter to add), wa-notes-btn, wa-notes-list, wa-note-input, wa-note-add, wa-note-del-{id}. Notes list items include author.name. Tags stored as JSON on whatsapp_conversations.tags and returned via present().
